test_rasterize_points_naive_cpu: test rasterize_points on CPU with naive binning to verify point cloud rasterization output
test_rasterize_points_cuda_binned: test rasterize_points on CUDA with coarse-to-fine binning for variable radius point clouds
test_rasterize_points_python: test rasterize_points_python pure Python implementation for CPU point cloud rasterization
test_rasterize_points_backward_grads: test backward gradient pass across CPU naive, CUDA naive, and CUDA binned rasterization pathways
test_rasterize_points_coarse_cpp: test the C++ _rasterize_points_coarse extension for binning points into spatial bins on CPU and CUDA
